business_problem: Beyond its Group function, Zurich consists of local business units (BUs) that are responsible for engaging customers directly in their respective countries, as well as growing revenue and generating their own profitability.
solution_summary: Zurich Insurance Group built this solution on Power BI, Power Automate, Dynamics 365. Beyond its Group function, Zurich consists of local business units (BUs) that are responsible for engaging customers directly in their respective countries, as well as growing revenue and generating their own profitability. Power BI publishes dashboards and self-service analytics to business users. Power Automate runs workflow automations and approvals across connected systems. Dynamics 365 provides the core business application experience for service, sales, or operations workflows. After looking for a new solution, several local and global BUs across all continents chose Microsoft Dynamics 365 Marketing, Dynamics 365 Sales, and Dynamics 365 Customer Service.
